annotations.text:
The one rule that changes the shipped app:
white text fails WCAG AA on all four brand colours (1.23–2.48:1).
Everything on a brand surface uses ink #2E2119 instead — 6.28:1 at worst.
The logo keeps its white lockup: it is large display lettering, not text.

Soft Marshmallow (the logo face) is not on Google Fonts, so it is not embedded here — the licensed file is needed for any display setting beyond the supplied logo artwork. Alexandria does all the text work and carries both scripts.
